name: noxia-skills
description: Clinical genetic analysis and reporting skills for the Noxia rare disease variant analysis platform

interface.shortDescription: Rare disease variant analysis, ACMG classification, and clinical reporting for Noxia
interface.longDescription: Use Noxia Skills to perform end-to-end clinical genetic analysis: create cases, upload VCFs, run phenotype-driven variant scans, classify variants with ACMG criteria, and draft clinical reports — or run everything unattended with the fast-forward skill. Includes phenotype-driven inference for negative WES results.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this rare disease case in Noxia.
Fast-forward case 42 — analyze and draft the report.
